_comment: THE list of mod modules CI builds and the launcher bundles (src/mods/versions/<module>).
Read by build-check.yml, launcher-release.yml (via tools/release/plan.py), the release's
'bundled jars present' assert, GitHub labels, and the installer's default-version picker.
Adding or removing a live version here is one of the promotion coupling points in
'covers' = human label for build jobs and release notes.
'java' (optional, default 21) = the JDK the module's Gradle build runs on; 26.x needs 25.
'versions' = the exact Minecraft versions that run this jar. MUST equal the launcher's
VersionManager.OriginBuilds entries for this jar - tools/release/check_consistency.py
'inworld' (optional, default false) = boot-smoke and the dev-shots design set end with the
in-world step: a flat test world, HUD + Mod Menu shots, Save and Quit (OriginDevWorld.inWorldTick).
Only for modules whose OriginDevWorld carries that step (test_ci_gates.py checks).
